text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 10, 2025) for 299 Forman Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (July 10, 2025) for 299 Forman Avenue, Folder Number 25 190953 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to May 29, 2026, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
